title: Race of the Sinking Crypt
story: Dunemaw the Sand Sifter yawns beneath the desert crypt, and every yawn pulls sand — and two trapped scholars — downward. The stone gate at the end of the long corridor is grinding shut and will seal in 75 seconds. Mr 6 shoulders both scholars and eyes the corridor.
question: The corridor is 480 feet long and Mr 6 can carry the scholars at 8 feet per second. If the gate seals in 75 seconds, how many seconds to spare will he have when he reaches it?
hint: First work out how long the run itself takes: 480 feet at 8 feet each second. Then compare that to 75.
victory: Mr 6 skidded through the gate with 15 whole seconds spare and used three of them to bow. Dunemaw got a mouthful of empty corridor and went back to sleep, thoroughly out-timed.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight sprinting down a torchlit sandstone corridor carrying two scholars as sand pours from the ceiling and a great stone gate grinds closed ahead.
praise: Using distance and speed together was the right plan - the last step was comparing that time to the 75-second gate.
